name: Nehemiah
overview: The book of Nehemiah reveals the faithfulness and leadership of Nehemiah, the son of Hachaliah and trusted cupbearer to King Artaxerxes, who was deeply grieved over the desolation of Jerusalem (Nehemiah 1:1, 1:11). God sovereignly used Nehemiah to obtain the king's favor to rebuild the walls of Jerusalem, demonstrating divine providence in restoration (Nehemiah 2:1). The narrative also highlights Nehemiah’s role in organizing the people, including registers of those who returned from exile with Zerubbabel, emphasizing the importance of spiritual and civic renewal under godly leadership (Ezra 2:2, Nehemiah 7:7).
